__note: LIBRARY MANIFEST — the per-library half of the whole code→canvas pipeline (docs/21). `ds-contracts promote --config <this>` runs the promote stage; `ds-contracts onboard --adopt examples/mui` runs capture → promote → emit → bundle → publish from it. packages/cli/src/promote.ts is the shared engine-free pipeline; nothing here is library-specific code.
__note:components: ORGANISM round appends checkbox, pagination and table (the composed DataTable — the first ORGANISM).
__note:contractStem: The emitted Figma script is named kebab(contract.name), so a promoted contract FILE must carry the same stem or the compile receipt cannot find it. Capture-dir names come from the capture config; this is the one place the two spellings differ.
